original: トムは何であんなことやったんだろう。

en.text: I wonder why Tom did that.
I wonder what Tom did that for.

original: 何でそう思うわけ？

en.text: What led you to believe so?

original: 今の時代、何でもありだからね。

en.text: In this day and age, anything's possible.

original: 何でこれ知らないんだよ。

en.text: How come you don't know this?

original: 「わぁ。シャツが後ろ前になってる。ちょっと、気付いてたでしょ？何で教えてくれないの？こんな格好で子供たちに偉そうに説教しちゃったよ」「いやぁ、『知らぬが仏』って言葉もあるし。黙っとく方がいいかなぁと思って」

en.text: "Eep, my shirt's on backward! Hold on, you already knew, didn't you? Why didn't you tell me? I literally just gave a big lecture looking like this!" "Well, they say ignorance is bliss. I just figured it'd be best if I didn't say anything."

original: 何で君はうちの回りをうろちょろしているの？

en.text: Why are you wandering around your house?
Why are you loitering around my house?

original: 「『~たら』形なんか、大嫌いだ。意味が分からないよ」「if ... then とか when とか after とか、そんな感じだよ」「あっ。分かった。でも、まだ好きじゃない」「何が嫌なの？」「何でもない」

en.text: "I hate the '～たら' ​form in Japanese. I just don't get it." "It means something like 'if so-and-so, then so-and-so', or 'when so-and-so', or 'after so-and-so', and stuff like that." "Ah, got it. But I still don't like it." "What don't you like?" "Never mind."

original: 何でトムはああも疑り深いのかね。

en.text: Why's Tom so suspicious?

original: 「お母さんって、何でそんなに家が好きなの？」「何でだろうね？お母さんもよくわかんない」「何それ？」「まぁ、いいじゃん。ご飯食べな」

en.text: "Mom, why do you like this house so much?" "Hmm, I don't really know why." "What?" "Oh, never mind that. Now eat your food."

original: 何でお前が行きたいのか、理解に苦しむよ。

en.text: It's difficult to understand why you want to go.

original: 何で毎日お昼ご飯抜いてるの？

en.text: Why do you skip lunch every day?

original: 「君って、結婚してるの？」「そうよ」「えっ。もしかして子持ちとか」「そうだけど。何か？」「いや、何でもない」「っていうかさぁ『ししゃも』みたいな言い方するの止めてくれる？」

en.text: "Are you married?" "Yeah I am." "Huh. Are you by chance expecting children or such?" "I am, but is there a reason you're asking?" "No, nothing at all." "More than that though, could you please stop speaking like you're a smelt."

original: 何で休んだかは知らないんだ。

en.text: I don't know the reason why he was absent.

original: 何で彼に怒ってるの？

en.text: Why are you angry with him?

original: 何で早めに去るの？

en.text: Why are you leaving early?

original: トムが何であんなに怒るのか理解できない。

en.text: I can't understand why Tom is so upset.

original: この箱、何でできてるか分かる？

en.text: Do you know what this box is made of?

en.text: Why is Tom here? He should be in school.
Why is Tom here? He's supposed to be at school.

original: 何でまだ終わってないの？

en.text: Why are you still not finished?

en.text: I don't know why I want it so much.

original: 何でマスクしてるの？

en.text: Why are you wearing a mask?

original: 「何のこと？」「何でもない」

en.text: "What did you talk about?" "Nothing."

original: 「おかえり。遅かったわね」「うん。いつも電動自転車で抜いてく奴がバッテリーが切れて自転車押してたから手伝ってた。電動自転車って、めっちゃ重いんだよ。びっくりした」「ふぅん。ところで、その子って、女の子？男の子？」「えっ」「何でもない。そうやって恋が芽生えるのかなって思って」

en.text: "Welcome back. You're later than usual." "Yeah. The person who's always passing me on their electric bike had their battery die and was pushing it, so I was helping them. Electric bikes are super heavy; it surprised me." "Hmm. By the way, this kid, is it a girl or boy?" "Huh?" "Never mind. I was just thinking, 'That's how love begins, isn't it?'"

original: メアリーって、何でああもトゲのある言い方するんだろうね？

en.text: I wonder why Mary always talks that harshly.

en.text: "Why's this medicine powder so sweet? It's like sugar!" "It contains erythritol."

en.text: "What did you say?" "Nothing. I was just talking to myself."

en.text: Why are you working for him?
